'''Myto's Arrow''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was discovered by its namesake, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Keos Myto]]. The route connected [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], located in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]], with the [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], part of this route was under the authority of the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. They allowed the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] to operate on and around [[Gabredor III/Legends|Gabredor III]], one of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in their section of the route.
